_README: This is the ONE file you must edit to make the pack yours. Put your own avatar + voice here. Nothing else in the pack hardcodes an identity. Fill every <PLACEHOLDER>.

me._heygen_avatar_id_note: The look/avatar id of YOUR trained HeyGen avatar. Get it with `heygen avatar looks list --group-id $AVATAR_GROUP_ID --ownership private` or from the HeyGen dashboard. It must support Avatar V (see SKILL.md).
me._elevenlabs_note: Required. This cloned voice is the only voice engine for the reels.
me.visual_reference_dir: <OPTIONAL: absolute path to a folder of real photos of the avatar person>
me._visual_reference_note: Used ONLY for likeness QA (does the render still look like the person?). Never used to generate. Leave empty if you don't have one.

visual_spec.name: my_avatar_v_canon
visual_spec.appearance_note: Face, hair and features are fixed by the trained HeyGen avatar. Do NOT describe invented facial features in prompts.
visual_spec.wardrobe: Whatever the trained avatar wears. Don't ask for per-scene outfit changes. A different outfit = a different look that must be declared explicitly.

background.note: Keep the look's own room background, approved by the user. Omit the `background` field from the HeyGen request and do not send `remove_background`.

visual_spec.framing_rationale: The active look is a close chest-up shot with no hands in frame, so the face leads the bottom 40% of the split.
negative_rules: no warping of hands/fingers or artifacts on the face
no crop that cuts the head or hides the hands when gestures were requested
no identity/avatar change between shots of the same reel
no generated backgrounds or background colors other than the declared one unless an approved brand system says so
no lipsync out of sync with audio_final
acceptance_checklist: full face in frame, no warping, no double face
native room background kept, not replaced by a flat color
lipsync matches audio_final (check hook, middle and close)
same avatar/look as the rest of the shots in the reel

me._preferred_voice_mode_note: "elevenlabs_tts" = your cloned voice speaks the script directly with ElevenLabs, no Gemini (see voice_generation_canon.elevenlabs_tts). "gemini_tts_only" = Gemini TTS is the final voice. "gemini_tts_elevenlabs" = Gemini TTS drives the performance, then ElevenLabs speech-to-speech swaps in your cloned voice (needs elevenlabs_voice_id + ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).

voice_generation_canon.name: default_reel_voice
voice_generation_canon._note: Define YOUR speaker here. These are neutral defaults — rewrite them to your character, language and accent. None of this is prescriptive.

gemini._voiceName_note: Pick one of the 30 Gemini voices (see tts-ugc/SKILL.md). Keep it consistent across all segments of a reel.
gemini.audio_profile: A Peruvian creator from Lima behind the brand Data Nube, giving a sharp personal opinion on the news straight to camera. Sounds like a real person with a point of view, not a TV anchor or radio announcer.
gemini.style: News opinion commentary: confident, direct and analytical, with conviction on the key point and a conversational, credible delivery.
gemini.accent: Native Peruvian Spanish from Lima (limeño): clear, well-articulated consonants and natural Lima intonation. Not Spain Spanish, not Mexican, not generic neutral Latin American.
gemini.pacing: Fast and punchy from the first word. Keep momentum, but make punchlines clear.
gemini.segment_pacing: Fast and punchy, but clear. Do not rush so much that words collapse.
gemini.energy: Medium-high, confident and engaged, rising on the main opinion.

post_processing._tempo_note: Optional speed-up for punchier UGC. 1.0 = no change. Raise toward 1.1-1.3 if your delivery feels slow. Apply AFTER concatenation, before any voice change.

elevenlabs_tts._note: eleven_v4 is text-to-speech only. It has no speech-to-speech mode, so it cannot replace the model in elevenlabs_sts.

_blocked_note: Optional safety net. If you keep multiple identities here, list any that must never be used as a silent fallback, e.g. { "someone_else": { "heygen_avatar_id": "...", "reason": "..." } }. identity_guard.py refuses to use a blocked id unless its owner is requested explicitly.
